PP-OCRv5 mobile detection and recognition models for ncnn.

Source: https://github.com/nihui/ncnn-android-ppocrv5 (app/src/main/assets,
app/src/main/jni/ppocrv5_dict.h), downloaded 2026-10-25.
Models: PaddleOCR PP-OCRv5 mobile, Apache License 2.0.
Conversion and dictionary: Tencent, BSD 3-Clause.

Embedded into libhardcopy_core by cpp/hardcopy/ocr/ppocr_models.cpp (.incbin).
